subject: MPF Contribution and Surcharge Notice - Kowloon Bay Dental Limited
body:
Dear Dr Leung Ka Yan,

We have received an MPF contribution and surcharge notice for Kowloon Bay Dental Limited from Pacific Star MPF Master Trust regarding the default mandatory contribution and 5% surcharge for September 2026.

Please arrange to pay the total amount of HK$33,075 by 14 November 2026. A scanned copy of the notice is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you need any assistance in arranging the payment.

Best regards,
XYZ CPA
